V-SS04/001EN
Majesty Lord Blaster
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC/RC):If "Blaster Blade" and "Blaster Dark" are in your soul, this unit gets [Critical] +1, and if this unit is on (VC), it gets [Power] +5000/drive +1.
[AUTO](VC):When it attacks, [COST][put two rear-guards into your soul], and get two Imaginary Gift:Force.

V-SS04/002EN
Knight of Silence, Gallatin
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 10000
-

V-SS04/003EN
Blaster Blade
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](VC):If you have four or more rear-guards, this unit gets [Critical] +1.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, and retire it.

Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000

V-SS04/005EN
Blaster Dark
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], your opponent chooses one of his or her rear-guards, and retires it.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:If your opponent has no rear-guards, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and this unit gets drive +1 until end of turn.
[CONT]:This card is also a 《Royal Paladin》.

V-SS04/006EN
Blaster Dark
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], your opponent chooses one of his or her rear-guards, and retires it.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:If your opponent has no rear-guards, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and this unit gets drive +1 until end of turn.

V-SS04/007EN
Star Call Trumpeter
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], return a card with "Blaster" in its card name and a "When Light and Darkness Intersects" each from your drop zone to your hand.
[CONT]:If you have a vanguard with "Blaster" in its card name, this unit gets "Boost".

V-SS04/008EN
Wingal Brave
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When its attack or the attack it boosted hits a vanguard, look at seven cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to one card with "Blaster" in its card name from among them and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-SS04/009EN
Cloud Lancer, Gmoris
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, put up to one grade 2 card from your drop zone on the top or bottom of your deck. If you put a card, this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

V-SS04/010EN
Knight of the Harp, Tristan
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Blaster Blade", reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-SS04/011EN
Pluck Enchanter
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC)[1/turn]:When your "Blaster Blade" is placed, you may [Soul-Charge 1]. If you [Soul-Charge], and there are no face up cards in your damage zone, [Counter-Charge 1].

Barcgal

V-SS04/017EN
When Light and Darkness Intersects
Normal Order｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power -｜ Shield -
Resolve one of the effects below, and shuffle your deck.
・If "Blaster Blade" is on your (VC) or (RC), search your deck for up to one "Blaster Dark", reveal it and put it into your hand.
・If "Blaster Dark" is on your (VC) or (RC), search your deck for up to one "Blaster Blade", reveal it and put it into your hand.
・If "Blaster Blade" and "Blaster Dark" are on your (VC) or (RC), search your deck for up to one "Majesty Lord Blaster", reveal it and put it into your hand..

Quick Shield
